new_results.summary: For Mahalanobis-normalized rank-d product-linear leakage Y and any nonincreasing radial kernel psi, E psi(|Y|) is bounded by the bathtub integral against the cap e^(d/2). Power kernels recover the prior negative-moment theorem; logarithmic kernels are uniformly integrable even for d=1.

For Q=2 U^T C V+R(V)+affine with no U-self quadratic term and independent cap-one original-coordinate blocks, ||p_Q||_infinity <= [e d/(2(d-1))] v_d^(1/d) (prod_{j<=d}s_j(C))^(-1/d) for every 2<=d<=rank C. In particular top two singular values give e sqrt(pi)/sqrt(s1*s2).
For iid uniform X,Y, 2XY has a logarithmically unbounded density and E|Y|^-1 diverges; rank-one raw reciprocal smoothing cannot be universal. This does not refute full QFORM.
